General Fees

Electronic Statement - Free

Statement Copies (free online) - $5.00 each

Account Histories Online - Free

Telephone Transfer - Free

Close Account within 90 Days of Opening - $25.00

Account Research - $25.00 per hours

Legal Processing Fee for Levies - $25.00

Share & Share Draft (Checking) Accounts

Monthly Service Charge - Free

Minimum Balance Checking - None

Member Privilege Fee (per presentment) - $32.00

Returned NSF Fee (per presentment) - $32.00

Returned Deposited Checks - $10.00 each

Over-the-Counter Checks $2.00 / 4 per page

Money Orders - $3.00 each

Wire Transfer (Outgoing Domestic) - $25.00 each

Wire Transfer (Outgoing Foreign) - $40.00 each

Photocopies - $0.75 per page

Fax Service (Outgoing Local) - $2.50 per page

Notary (Member) - Free

Notary (Non-member) - $5.00 per page
